gre.detail: GMAT or GRE required; send official scores (GRE institution 4007; GMAT 0GZ-1R-80). ASU does not accept GRE General Test at-home. Case-by-case waiver: request via optional essay in application with justification (W. P. Carey Full-time MBA How to apply).

gmat.detail: GMAT or GRE required (institutional code 0GZ-1R-80). Waiver eligibility via optional essay request; not an automatic/program-wide waiver.

toefl.detail: Required if native language is not English. W. P. Carey states graduate minimums may be higher than ASU general; exact Full-time MBA numeric mins not printed on program page. ASU Grad general (exams before Jan 21 2026): iBT 80; on/after Jan 21 2026: total 4. ASU does not accept TOEFL iBT Home/Paper Edition or Essentials for this WPC MBA page note (Home Edition accepted university-wide only for exams on/after Jan 21 2026 per Admission Services). Confirm current WPC MBA threshold with admissions.

ielts.detail: Accepted as proof of English proficiency when required. ASU Grad general Academic overall ≥6.5; W. P. Carey may set higher—exact Full-time MBA IELTS min not printed on program How-to-apply page.

english.waiver: ASU English proficiency exemptions apply (citizenship on ASU English-speaking country list; U.S. degree; medium-of-instruction documentation; other form-based exemptions on Admission Services English proficiency page). WPC Full-time MBA: international applicants follow same process as domestic plus English proof if required; after admission, visa/financial guarantee steps.

gpa.detail: ASU Degree Search (BAFULLMBA): minimum cumulative GPA 3.00 (4.00 scale) in last 60 hours of first bachelor’s, or 3.00 in an applicable master’s.

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: Degree Search requires two letters commenting on motivation, commitment, achievements, work experience, and success potential. Online application collects recommender contact (name, affiliation, work email).

statementOfPurpose.detail: Admission essay / short essay responses in graduate application (personal statements not accepted). Degree Search: responses to short-answer questions.

resume.detail: Current resume with positions held and Month/Year employment dates.

transcripts.detail: Unofficial acceptable at application; if admitted, official transcripts from every college/university awarding bachelor’s or higher. ASU alumni need not resubmit ASU transcripts. International: original language + official English translation.

interview.detail: ASU Degree Search: personal interview arranged by invitation only must be completed before an offer of admission.

applicationFee.waivers: Military and Citizen Service fee waiver for U.S. Military, Teach for America, Peace Corps, or AmeriCorps—email wpcareymasters@asu.edu before submitting.
applicationFee.detail: $70 domestic; $115 international (non-refundable). Applications not processed until fee received.

other: Fall 2027 rounds: R1 Oct 15 2026; R2 Dec 1 2026; R3 (Priority International) Feb 1 2027; R4 (Final) Apr 1 2027; rolling until Jul 15 2027

gre.detail: All candidates must take GMAT, GMAT Focus, or GRE before the round deadline. No minimum score; quantitative section emphasized. Fall 2027: official scores from exams on/after Oct 1 2021. GRE code 0574. No test-waiver path stated on Haas GMAT/GRE page.

gmat.detail: GMAT/GMAT Focus accepted (institution N2VPT47). Required with GRE as alternative; no minimum. Updated scores considered if received ≥2 weeks before round notification deadline.

ielts.detail: Academic IELTS overall BAND ≥7 with Speaking/Writing ≥6.5. Fall 2027: exams on/after Jun 1 2025. Electronic from test center.

gpa.detail: No published minimum GPA on Application page; class profile cites average ~3.65 as descriptive only.

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: Two professional letters required; one from current direct supervisor.

resume.detail: Current resume via online application; PDF preferred.

transcripts.detail: Transcripts from all undergraduate and graduate programs attended or attending.

applicationRequirements.advice: No published GMAT/GRE waiver—plan to test. Video essay is required. Interview invitation is mandatory path to admission.

gmat.detail: GMAT/GMAT Focus accepted (code H9X-9F-34). Required except UChicago undergrad/alumni optional path. Official scores after admit/accept unless expiring sooner.

ielts.detail: IELTS Academic minimum overall 7 when English exam required. PTE 70 and Duolingo 135 also listed.

gpa.detail: Undergraduate degree from accredited U.S. college/university or equivalent required; no published minimum GPA on requirements/how-to-apply pages.

lettersOfRecommendation.detail: One letter preferably from current supervisor; explain if unable. Online form only (no email/post/fax).

statementOfPurpose.detail: Four required short-answer prompts (300 characters each): immediate post-MBA goal; long-term goal; upload image + significance; fun fact/unique about yourself. Optional clarification essay (max 300 words).

resume.detail: Professional resume highlighting experiences relevant to Full-Time MBA candidacy.

statementOfPurpose.detail: One required written essay (max 500 words)—choose 1 of 2 prompts (uncertainty/action or professional/personal transformation). Required video essay on post-MBA career goals (up to 2 minutes). Optional essay for gaps/context/reapplicant strengthening.

resume.detail: 1–2 page resume; standard 12-pt font; include Month/Year start and end dates for each role.

transcripts.detail: Unofficial scanned university transcripts (not web/portal downloads) from all undergrad/grad; degree name/conferral; grading scale; translations if needed. Official after admit.

ielts.detail: IELTS Academic overall 7.0 with Speaking and Writing ≥7.0. DET overall 120 also accepted. Electronic to Cornell Two Year MBA Admissions.
